message: The server serves every file it holds over iroh: Object Storage is cold storage behind its iroh store — a device's get is held (iroh-blobs provider events, Intercept) while the file comes up from the bucket into the store, hashed on the way in and kept only if it is the hash asked for, then iroh answers it natively (BLAKE3-verified streaming); one bringing-up per file, four at once; a bounded cache pinned by cache/<hash> tags, least recently asked-for let go past VAULT_IROH_CACHE_GB (default 20), never while sending, never the vault/ files the server made; the files taken out of iroh-docs' GC protection so the cache really shrinks; pushes into the server's store refused (0.103 applies the get mask to every request kind) (#69)
